title: CVM commitment-proposal review did not establish customer compensation
notes: Primary CVM material concerning a proposed settlement by two BlueBenx-related respondents states that the proposal did not include correction of the alleged irregularities through return of the benefit obtained or compensation for alleged diffuse market damages. This is regulatory-process evidence only. It does not establish that individual BlueBenx customers received no recovery, and it is not treated as a creditor or repayment proceeding.
